verdict.rationale: Ironclad provides building blocks for background automation: event-driven webhooks with signing, authentication and auto-deactivation monitoring; API-launched and bulk-launched workflows; and integrations that can automatically block or push forward approvals or run AI-driven analysis. However, the autonomous logic must be built and hosted by the user as external integration code. The only native option evidenced is Workflow Designer, a workflow-publishing tool, with no evidence that it runs automations unattended. missing for 10: native in-product autonomous/scheduled automation or agent runs, no-code background automation builder evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
